description: Create synthetic-audience personas to simulate against. Describe who you want to model and get back personas (with ids) you can then target as the 'audience' in aetherya_audit_site, aetherya_test_copy, or aetherya_ask_audience. These are SIMULATED personas (engine-generated), not real people. Returns the created personas inline.

brand_context.description: Optional. The brand under test and its competitors, so personas carry brand awareness for that market. Requires segments or website_url; otherwise it is rejected.

category.description: Optional. A category/segment label for the audience (e.g. 'e-commerce', 'fintech').

count.description: How many synthetic personas to create (1-25, default 3).

description.description: Who to simulate, in plain language (e.g. 'price-sensitive first-time SaaS buyers in Germany' or 'busy parents shopping for groceries online'). When provided, Aetherya engine-generates personas matching it; omit for a general-consumer audience.

language.description: Optional. Language for the personas, e.g. 'ro'.

market.description: Optional. Target market / locale as a country or region (e.g. 'US', 'DE', 'UK').

pack_name.description: Optional. Name for the saved audience pack.

segments.description: Optional. Explicit audience segments (max 12); weights follow 'size'. Builds a manual blueprint.

brand_awareness.description: How familiar this segment is with the brand.

key.description: Stable id for the segment, e.g. 'loyal_buyers'.

relationship_to_brand.description: Free text, e.g. 'switched to a competitor last year'.

website_url.description: Optional. A site to infer the audience from — Aetherya analyzes it and generates personas that match its likely visitors.

name: aetherya_create_audience
title: Create a synthetic audience
